turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Of course! One example first.
I walk to school. My friend walks to school.
"My friend" is one person, like he or she, so I add -s.
After he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: He works here. Wrong: He work here.

Now your turn. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
